versions.changelog:
- Initial release providing access to the official Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) OpenAPI data.
- Supports queries for daily stock OHLC, P/E ratio, dividend yield, P/B, TAIEX index history, company profiles, financial statements, monthly revenue, margin trading, block trades, ESG disclosures, warrants, broker data, and trading calendar.
- Fetches full datasets per endpoint; client-side filtering by stock code or criteria is required.
- Handles both English and Traditional Chinese JSON field names as returned by different endpoints.
- Includes detailed usage notes, endpoint list, and mapping between tasks and endpoints for easy integration.
